name: Agent Manage Bot
tagline: A control room for Grok bots paired with Mac command-line tools
description: Sits above a two-tier setup where Grok bots handle the thinking and Mac command-line tools do the executing. Work is sorted into separate research and coding rooms, briefs that missed their slot get chased, and a recurring lab session keeps the rig exercised. Terminal sessions underneath stay attached to each layer.
